name: Plum and Snow (Mai Tuyết Song Bảo)

bonuses.effect: Bare Branch Blooms (Khô Chi Khai Hoa)
bonuses.rule: while you fight with no companion and are below half health, each Petal you hold adds 6 % sword crit damage; when Last Blossom saves you, you gain five Petals.

story: His sworn brother's sword and his village's cloak. Lăng Đạp Tuyết holds both.
